verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair axis for an AI code-review platform, since it could plausibly ship scheduled codebase scans or reports. The evidence only shows event-triggered automation (automatic reviews on new PRs, auto-fix on each review) and on-demand actions (comment-triggered reviews, codebase scans with no stated cadence). Neither is a recurring schedule, and no documented cron, interval, or scheduled-workflow feature appears.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
